title: Response-free mathematical qualification of moment-enriched theta-profile reconstruction
scientific_question: Does the all-layer moment-enriched conservation-native theta-polynomial reconstruction define a unique, admissible and numerically stable hydraulic profile map over a prospectively frozen synthetic B14 state/moment domain before any hydrological response is attempted?

hydraulic_relation: psi(theta) is the frozen B14 inverse retention map on the unsaturated branch
reconstruction.degree_count: 2N unknown higher-mode coefficients and 2N hydraulic constraints for N all-moment-enriched layers
reconstruction.state_recovery: Storage and centered first moment are exact analytically by Legendre orthogonality and are not numerical residuals.

physical_moment_domain.bounded_theta_exact_moment_limit: For mean effective saturation Se_bar and layer width d, |M| <= 0.5*(theta_s-theta_r)*d^2*Se_bar*(1-Se_bar).
physical_moment_domain.derivation: The extremum under theta_r<=theta<=theta_s places all excess water at one layer edge; the residual theta_r background has zero centered moment.
physical_moment_domain.note: C5Z deliberately remains away from the box-constraint extreme |mu|=1.

numerical_contract.solver: scipy.optimize.least_squares on the square 2N residual system using method='trf' and fixed residual scaling
numerical_contract.admissibility_sampling: 65 equally spaced xi points per layer including faces

jacobian_condition_diagnostic.reason: Condition number is reported as numerical conditioning evidence but no post-hoc universal threshold is imposed.

invalid_trial_handling.rule: If any hydraulic face theta required to evaluate a residual is outside the constitutive Se domain or non-finite, return a deterministic finite penalty vector; do not clip theta and do not evaluate a constitutive continuation.
invalid_trial_handling.qualification_effect: A final solution with any sampled theta outside the domain fails G4 regardless of solver success.

qualification_gates.G1_STATE_MOMENT_BOUNDS: All prescribed S,M pairs satisfy the exact theta-box moment limit prospectively.
qualification_gates.G2_ALL_CASES_CONVERGE: Every fixed start converges for every synthetic case under frozen solver settings.
qualification_gates.G3_UNIQUE_NUMERICAL_BRANCH: All five fixed starts converge to the same admissible profile within the frozen solution-agreement tolerances.
qualification_gates.G4_THETA_ADMISSIBILITY: All sampled theta values in every solved layer remain within the frozen constitutive Se domain [0.02,0.995].
qualification_gates.G5_HYDRAULIC_CONTINUITY: Pressure and flux continuity plus top/bottom boundary residuals pass their physical-unit gates.
qualification_gates.G6_STATE_RECOVERY: Analytic storage and first-moment recovery from the polynomial coefficients matches the prescribed S,M to machine-level algebraic identity.
qualification_gates.G7_NO_RESPONSE_DATA: No C5R/C5N/C5P hydrological trajectory is consumed or generated.

decision_logic.C5Z_MOMENT_PROFILE_NUMERICALLY_MULTIBRAN: G1/G2 may pass but G3, G4 or G5 fails.
decision_logic.next_if_qualified: Authorize a separate frozen-state moment-state sufficiency discriminator before any free-running moment-ROM implementation.
decision_logic.next_if_not_qualified: Stop the moment-enriched theta-polynomial route without tuning polynomial order, moment range, solver starts or tolerances.

stop_rules: No hydrological response data may be read or generated in C5Z.
No moment localization choice; every retained layer is moment-enriched in C5Z.
No moment-domain narrowing, solver-start change, residual scaling change or tolerance retuning after response.
No application, performance, speed or production-ROM claim.

implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: Synthetic B14 moment/state algebraic qualification only; no hydrological response or free-running moment-ROM.
implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: Hydrological trajectories, response-fitted moment localization, polynomial-order changes, solver/tolerance retuning after result.
